gaps: P0–P2: none; P5: none; P6: only astronaut photos from orbit
notes: #1 and #2 are two photographs of the same Constantin drawing (MET dates it about 1773–92); #2 is the larger, cleaner copy. #3 (photochrom of the Saint-Sauveur cloister) is a color alternative for P4 but low resolution and only a cloister walk. #5 is Cézanne’s Jas de Bouffan, a country house outside town. #6–#9 are ISS photos where the city is a smudge.
